title: Preregistration
description: Frozen decision criteria, written BEFORE the work runs. Criteria chosen after seeing results are not criteria. dw_verdict.py freeze stamps frozen_sha256; eval refuses to score if the content no longer matches the hash; a retry requires a NEW pre-registration, never an edit.

question.description: The one question this run answers

intent.description: What the user actually wants — from the directive's WHAT'S ASKED parse

non_goals.description: Explicitly registered so the run cannot drift into them

baselines.description: The cheapest already-available alternatives any positive claim must beat — the honest bar

honest_prior.description: Predicted outcome, written before running. Being wrong here is information, not failure.

gates.description: Instrument-correctness checks. A gate failure means the run is INVALID (NO_VERDICT) — findings from a broken instrument are not findings. Gates can fail the run; findings never can.

criteria.description: The claims under test. kind=positive criteria decide PASS/FAIL/NULL; kind=null_evidence criteria (a permutation null, a decoy comparison, a power statement) upgrade NULL to CERTIFIED_NULL. predicate=null marks a criterion only LLM judgment can assess — it is labeled MANUAL and can never mint a computed verdict.

null_is_valid.description: true = a NULL outcome is a recorded, acceptable result (recorded permanently, never deleted or silently retried)

verdict_semantics.description: Both branches pre-committed: what action follows each outcome, decided before any outcome exists

deviation_policy.description: The only policy: divergence from this prereg is disclosed in the synthesis artifact's deviations[], at the point of deviation

frozen_sha256.description: Set by dw_verdict.py freeze over the canonicalized content (excluding this field). Presence = frozen; eval refuses without it.

field.description: Dotted path into the results JSON
